en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Hammad, from Al Mufazzal who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘How were you<sup>asws</sup> all when you<sup>asws</sup> were in the shadows?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Mufazzal! We<sup>asws</sup> were with of our<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> There wasn’t anyone with Him<sup>azwj</sup> apart from us<sup>asws</sup> in the green shadow. We<sup>asws</sup> praised Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> extolled His<sup>azwj</sup> Holiness, and we<sup>asws</sup> extolled His<sup>azwj</sup> Oneness, and we<sup>asws</sup> Praised Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and there was none from an Angel of Proximity nor anyone with a spirit apart from us<sup>asws</sup> until there was a beginning for it in the creation of the things. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired from the Angels and others, then the knowledge of that ended up to us<sup>asws</sup>’.
